text: A young man among idols who would not bow. A son who spoke gently to a father who threatened him. A young man in the fire. A father in a dry valley. A father and son raising the foundations of a House for all people.
Every time, he turned to Allah. And every time, Allah was enough for him.
Allah says: "There has already been for you an excellent pattern in Abraham and those with him."
And Allah kept his name with ours: every time we send blessings on the Prophet, peace be upon him, as he taught us, we name Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim.
So when you feel alone, say what he said as they threw him into the fire: حَسْبُنَا اللّٰهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيْلُ. Allah is enough for us, and He is the best Guardian.
